product.name: TAGAS Men's Regular Jacket
product.description: A regular-fit men's casual bomber-style jacket with a low-cut standing ribbed collar, long sleeves, smooth zip closure and multiple pockets. Designed for casual wear and colder weather.

review_summary.summary: Most available reviews are positive and repeatedly mention good fit, comfort, lightweight feel, appearance and value for money. Black, grey and navy variants all receive positive feedback. However, one reviewer described the product as very bad and another said the fabric was average, so the jacket should be positioned as a budget-value product rather than premium outerwear.
positive: Good fit reported by multiple buyers
Multiple buyers considered the quality good
negative: One reviewer gave a 1-star rating and called it a very bad product
One reviewer considered the fabric average
Quality may not meet premium-jacket expectations
Some feedback is extremely brief and provides little detail
Value perception is strongly connected to the low price
review_summary.main_concern: The main weakness is inconsistent quality perception. Most reviews are positive, but the available sample includes a strong negative review and one explicit complaint that the fabric could be better.

appearance.note: Multiple reviewers describe the jacket as stylish, classy, good-looking or fantastic.

fit.note: Multiple reviews report good, full or perfect fitting, while the official listing specifies regular fit.

fabric_quality.note: Several reviewers praise quality, but one reviewer explicitly says the fabric is average and could be better.

weight.note: Multiple reviews describe the jacket as lightweight. The listed item weight is 200 grams.

value_for_money.note: Several buyers describe the product as value for money, particularly at its low price.

style.note: The bomber/track-jacket styling and appearance receive repeated positive comments.

cold_weather_suitability.note: Amazon positions the jacket for winter and cold weather, but customer reviews primarily discuss lightweight construction rather than warmth.

durability.note: The available reviews do not provide enough evidence to make a strong durability claim.

pros: Available in Black, Grey and Navy
cons: Fabric quality may feel average to some buyers
Limited evidence about insulation or warmth

not_ideal_for: Customers looking for heavy insulated winter jackets
buying_advice.size_advice: The product is officially listed as regular fit and multiple reviews report good or perfect fitting. Customers should still check the size chart before purchasing, especially when choosing between adjacent sizes.
buying_advice.weather_advice: The listing positions this jacket for winter and cold weather, but customer reviews repeatedly describe it as lightweight. Do not present it as a heavy winter or highly insulated jacket.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Position the jacket around its fit, lightweight construction, casual styling and value rather than premium fabric quality.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the regular fit, bomber-style appearance, lightweight feel, multiple pockets and strong value-for-money feedback. Avoid making unsupported claims about waterproofing, insulation or premium durability.

warning_attributes: average fabric reported by one reviewer

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Give a concise overview covering the bomber-style design, regular fit, polyester-cotton material, lightweight construction, zipper closure, pockets, price, colors, sizes and key review insights.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Recommend it as a budget-value jacket. Highlight the strong feedback around fit, comfort, lightweight construction, appearance and value, while mentioning that fabric quality is not consistently described as premium.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Explain that the jacket is officially regular fit and multiple buyers report good or perfect fitting. Recommend checking the size chart before ordering.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_winter: Explain that the listing positions the jacket for winter and cold weather, but it is lightweight and should not be presented as a heavy insulated winter jacket.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_quality: Say that most available reviews are positive about quality, but one reviewer specifically considered the fabric average. Position it as good value rather than premium quality.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_colors: Available local product images are Black, Grey and Navy.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_waterproofing: Do not claim that the jacket is waterproof or rainproof because the provided product information does not establish waterproof performance.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_hood: Do not claim that the jacket has a hood. The provided product information identifies a standing collar instead.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: Prioritize jackets with similar casual or bomber styling and a similar budget. If the customer prioritizes premium fabric, insulation or waterproofing, recommend a product with stronger verified evidence for those attributes.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Do not recommend this jacket solely because it has a 4.2 rating. Consider the customer's budget, desired fit, weather requirements, quality expectations and intended use.
